overview_description.description: Upfort is a cyber security and insurance platform that offers comprehensive protection to SMEs against evolving cyber threats. It allows organizations to fully address their cyber security needs–from risk management tools to insurance policies–through one easy-to-use platform. Its software provides phishing simulation, public Wi-Fi protection, inbox protection, password management, and cyber liability insurance.

about_short_description.short_description: Upfort is a cyber security and insurance platform that offers comprehensive protection against evolving cyber threats.

product.name: Upfort Shield
product.description: A multi-layer cybersecurity platform providing AI-powered protection against ransomware, phishing, wire fraud, and data breaches for organizations of all sizes.

product.name: Inbox Defender
product.description: AI-powered email security solution that detects and blocks phishing, ransomware, and financial fraud through real-time threat detection and attachment scanning.

product.name: Guardian
product.description: An AI-driven extended detection and response solution that monitors devices, networks, and cloud environments to detect and contain cyber threats.

product.name: Sentry
product.description: Automated attack surface monitoring tool that continuously scans IT assets for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations to reduce exploitable cyber risk.

product.name: Cyber University
product.description: A security training platform offering automated, interactive courses and phishing simulations to reduce employee susceptibility to cyber attacks.

product.name: Phishing Sims
product.description: A tool to launch mock phishing campaigns that simulate real-world attacks to test and improve employee readiness against phishing threats.
